ESP32-S3 Local AI Voice Assistant — V1 Installation Guide

ESP32-S3 Local AI Voice Assistant — V1 Installation Guide

1. V1 系统目标

第一版系统实现：

INMP441 Microphone
        ↓ I2S
     ESP32-S3
        ↓ Wi-Fi / WAV
Voice Server :8080
        ↓
SenseVoice ASR :8000
        ↓
Strata / Qwen LLM
        ↓
Sherpa-ONNX TTS
        ↓ WAV
     ESP32-S3
        ↓ I2S
    MAX98357A
        ↓
      Speaker

V1 已经完成：

  • ESP32-S3 麦克风录音

  • Wi-Fi 上传 WAV

  • 本地 SenseVoice ASR

  • Strata Qwen LLM

  • 本地 Sherpa-ONNX 中文 TTS

  • WAV 返回 ESP32

  • MAX98357A 播放 AI 回答

目前采用固定 6 秒录音，主要用于验证整个端到端架构。

Part 1 — 基本环境设置

2. 当前测试硬件

服务器测试环境：

Windows 11
WSL2
Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS
NVIDIA Quadro RTX 4000 8GB

ESP32：

ESP32-S3-WROOM-1
N16R8

3. WSL GPU 检查

进入 Ubuntu：

nvidia-smi

测试环境成功识别：

Quadro RTX 4000
8192 MiB VRAM
CUDA available

Part 2 — ASR Server / Port 8000

4. 创建项目目录

mkdir -p ~/voice-ai
cd ~/voice-ai

建立 ASR Python 环境：

python3 -m venv venv
source venv/bin/activate

python -m pip install --upgrade pip

确认：

python --version

测试环境使用：

Python 3.12

5. 安装 PyTorch GPU

测试环境：

pip install torch torchaudio \
  --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu128

检查：

python - <<'PY'
import torch

print("PyTorch:", torch.__version__)
print("CUDA:", torch.version.cuda)
print("CUDA available:", torch.cuda.is_available())

if torch.cuda.is_available():
    print("GPU:", torch.cuda.get_device_name(0))
PY

测试结果：

PyTorch 2.11.0+cu128
CUDA runtime 12.8
CUDA available True
GPU Quadro RTX 4000

6. 安装 SenseVoice / FunASR

pip install numpy funasr modelscope huggingface_hub

以及 API Server 需要的组件：

pip install fastapi uvicorn python-multipart

7. 启动 ASR Server

每次启动：

cd ~/voice-ai
source venv/bin/activate

funasr-server \
  --model sensevoice \
  --device cuda \
  --host 0.0.0.0 \
  --port 8000

这里非常重要：

--host 0.0.0.0

不能只监听：

127.0.0.1

否则 ESP32 无法通过 LAN 访问。

8. ASR Health Test

另外打开一个 Terminal：

curl http://127.0.0.1:8000/health

正常：

{
  "status":"ok",
  "device":"cuda",
  "models_loaded":["sensevoice"]
}

检查端口：

ss -lntp | grep 8000

应看到：

0.0.0.0:8000

Part 3 — TTS 环境

9. 为什么最终使用 Sherpa-ONNX

最开始测试 Kokoro，但遇到：

OverflowError:
Python int too large to convert to C ssize_t

问题发生在：

Kokoro
 ↓
spaCy
 ↓
en_core_web_sm
 ↓
Tokenizer

Python 3.12 和独立 Python 3.11 环境均出现相同问题，因此 V1 停止继续处理 Kokoro。

最终选择：

Sherpa-ONNX
+
MeloTTS Chinese/English VITS

优点：

  • 中文支持好

  • 支持中英文混合

  • CPU 即可运行

  • 不占用 ASR GPU

  • 速度快

  • ONNX 部署简单

  • 很适合实时语音设备

10. TTS Python 环境

使用独立环境：

cd ~/voice-ai

python3 -m venv tts-sherpa
source tts-sherpa/bin/activate

pip install --upgrade pip

pip install sherpa-onnx soundfile

这样 ASR 和 TTS Python dependencies 完全隔离。

11. 下载中文/英文 TTS 模型

mkdir -p ~/voice-ai/models
cd ~/voice-ai/models

下载：

https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/releases/download/tts-models/vits-melo-tts-zh_en.tar.bz2

解压：

tar xvf vits-melo-tts-zh_en.tar.bz2
rm vits-melo-tts-zh_en.tar.bz2

目录：

~/voice-ai/models/vits-melo-tts-zh_en/

model.onnx
tokens.txt
lexicon.txt
dict/

date.fst
number.fst
new_heteronym.fst

V1 使用：

model.onnx

Part 4 — LLM / Strata

12. Strata LLM

当前 LLM：

qwen3.8-flash-next-iq2_xs

API：

https://strata.5742868.xyz/v1/chat/completions

模型检查：

curl https://strata.5742868.xyz/v1/models

测试确认模型为 loaded，并具有 65536 context。

13. 非常重要：关闭 Thinking

最初测试：

/no_think

并不能真正关闭 reasoning。

返回仍然包含：

reasoning_content

一次简单的 9 × 17 请求约需要：

2.02 seconds


真正有效的方法是：

"chat_template_kwargs": {
    "enable_thinking": false
}

同样问题：

9 × 17

降低到：

0.682 seconds

并且不再产生 reasoning_content。

因此 Voice Server 必须使用：

"chat_template_kwargs": {
    "enable_thinking": False
}

而不是依赖：

/no_think

Part 5 — Voice Server / Port 8080

14. Voice Server 环境

cd ~/voice-ai

python3 -m venv voice-server
source voice-server/bin/activate

pip install --upgrade pip

pip install \
  fastapi \
  uvicorn \
  python-multipart \
  requests \
  sherpa-onnx \
  soundfile

Voice Server 负责：

POST /voice
      ↓
SenseVoice
      ↓
Strata Qwen
      ↓
Sherpa TTS
      ↓
WAV Response

ESP32 因此只需要知道一个 API：

http://SERVER_IP:8080/voice

15. Voice Server 关键配置

ASR：

ASR_URL = \
"http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/audio/transcriptions"

LLM：

STRATA_URL = \
"https://strata.5742868.xyz/v1/chat/completions"

STRATA_MODEL = \
"qwen3.8-flash-next-iq2_xs"

TTS：

~/voice-ai/models/vits-melo-tts-zh_en/

LLM 建议：

"max_tokens": 160,
"temperature": 0.7,
"top_p": 0.8,

"chat_template_kwargs": {
    "enable_thinking": False
}

System Prompt 应强调：

语音回答
简洁自然
通常 1–3 句话
不要 Markdown
中文问题使用中文
英文问题使用英文

16. 启动 Voice Server

第二个 Terminal：

cd ~/voice-ai
source voice-server/bin/activate

uvicorn voice_server:app \
  --host 0.0.0.0 \
  --port 8080

Part 7 — ESP32

19. ESP32 Audio Hardware

INMP441

INMP441       ESP32-S3

VDD    →      3V3
GND    →      GND
SCK    →      GPIO4
WS     →      GPIO5
SD     →      GPIO6
L/R    →      GND

MAX98357A

MAX98357A     ESP32-S3

VIN    →      5V
GND    →      GND
BCLK   →      GPIO15
LRC    →      GPIO16
DIN    →      GPIO17

Speaker 直接连接 MAX98357A：

Speaker + → Amplifier +
Speaker - → Amplifier -

Speaker - 不连接 ESP32 GND。

20. ESP32 V1 工作模式

服务器：

const char* VOICE_URL =
    "http://192.168.86.45:8080/voice";

录音：

#define RECORD_SECONDS 6
#define SAMPLE_RATE 16000

格式：

16 kHz
16-bit
Mono PCM

ESP32 在 PCM 前增加 WAV Header，然后：

POST /voice
multipart/form-data

服务器返回：

44100 Hz
16-bit
Mono WAV

ESP32 读取 WAV sample rate，重新初始化 I2S，然后通过 MAX98357A 播放。

Part 8 — WSL 网络问题

21. WSL2 LAN Access

这是本次部署中一个比较重要的问题。

WSL 内：

curl http://127.0.0.1:8000/health

正常。

Windows：

http://localhost:8000

也正常。

但：

http://192.168.86.45:8000

Windows 本机访问出现异常。

最终手机通过同一 Wi-Fi：

http://192.168.86.45:8000/health

却可以正常访问。

ESP32 同样可以正常访问。

22. WSL Mirrored Networking

Windows：

notepad $env:USERPROFILE\.wslconfig

设置：

[wsl2]
networkingMode=mirrored

然后：

wsl --shutdown

重新启动 WSL。

WSL：

ip addr

测试环境中 WSL 与 Windows 均获得：

192.168.86.45

23. Firewall

测试过程中增加过：

New-NetFirewallRule `
  -DisplayName "WSL FunASR 8000" `
  -Direction Inbound `
  -Protocol TCP `
  -LocalPort 8000 `
  -Action Allow

以及 Hyper-V inbound 设置。

但值得注意：

Windows 自己访问自己的 LAN IP 失败，并不意味着其他 LAN 设备访问失败。

手机和 ESP32 的实际测试比 Windows 本机 LAN-IP loopback 更有参考价值。

Part 9 — Ubuntu 部署建议

后期如果把系统部署到真正的 Ubuntu 主机：

ESP32
 ↓ Wi-Fi
Ubuntu Server
 ├── SenseVoice :8000
 ├── Voice Server :8080
 └── Sherpa TTS

会比：

Windows
 ↓
WSL2
 ↓
Ubuntu

简单很多。

可以避免：

  • WSL NAT / Mirrored networking

  • Hyper-V Firewall

  • Windows Firewall

  • Windows ↔ WSL localhost 转发

  • WSL shutdown 后服务消失

因此：

开发阶段使用 WSL2 很方便；长期运行建议原生 Ubuntu。

{"detail":"ASR failed: ..."}

Kokoro spaCy Error

Sherpa-ONNX + MeloTTS

Part 5 — 完整 Voice Server 程序

程序必须保存为：

/home/tommy/voice-ai/voice_server.py

创建：

nano ~/voice-ai/voice_server.py

粘贴下面完整程序：

import io
import time
from pathlib import Path

import requests
import soundfile as sf
import sherpa_onnx

from fastapi import FastAPI, UploadFile, File, HTTPException
from fastapi.responses import Response


# ============================================================
# Configuration
# ============================================================

ASR_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/audio/transcriptions"

STRATA_URL = "https://strata.5742868.xyz/v1/chat/completions"

STRATA_MODEL = "qwen3.8-flash-next-iq2_xs"

MODEL_DIR = (
    Path.home()
    / "voice-ai"
    / "models"
    / "vits-melo-tts-zh_en"
)


SYSTEM_PROMPT = """
你是一个运行在语音设备上的智能语音助手。

回答自然、简洁，适合直接使用语音播放。
通常回答一到三句话。
除非用户明确要求详细解释，否则不要长篇回答。
不要使用 Markdown、标题、表格。
用户主要说中文时使用中文回答。
用户主要说英文时使用英文回答。
中英文混合时，根据主要语言自然回答。
不要描述你的思考过程。
"""


# ============================================================
# FastAPI
# ============================================================

app = FastAPI(
    title="ESP32 AI Voice Server",
    version="1.0"
)


# ============================================================
# Sherpa TTS
# ============================================================

print("Loading Sherpa TTS...")


tts_config = sherpa_onnx.OfflineTtsConfig(

    model=sherpa_onnx.OfflineTtsModelConfig(

        vits=sherpa_onnx.OfflineTtsVitsModelConfig(

            model=str(MODEL_DIR / "model.onnx"),

            lexicon=str(MODEL_DIR / "lexicon.txt"),

            tokens=str(MODEL_DIR / "tokens.txt"),

            dict_dir=str(MODEL_DIR / "dict"),
        ),

        num_threads=4,

        debug=False,

        provider="cpu",
    ),

    rule_fsts=",".join([
        str(MODEL_DIR / "phone.fst"),
        str(MODEL_DIR / "date.fst"),
        str(MODEL_DIR / "number.fst"),
        str(MODEL_DIR / "new_heteronym.fst"),
    ]),
)


tts = sherpa_onnx.OfflineTts(tts_config)

print("Sherpa TTS loaded.")


# ============================================================
# Qwen / Strata
# ============================================================

def call_strata(user_text: str) -> str:

    payload = {

        "model": STRATA_MODEL,

        "messages": [

            {
                "role": "system",
                "content": SYSTEM_PROMPT,
            },

            {
                "role": "user",
                "content": user_text,
            }
        ],

        "max_tokens": 160,

        "temperature": 0.7,

        "top_p": 0.8,

        # IMPORTANT:
        # This actually disables Qwen thinking.
        "chat_template_kwargs": {
            "enable_thinking": False
        },

        "stream": False,
    }


    start = time.time()


    response = requests.post(
        STRATA_URL,
        json=payload,
        timeout=60
    )


    elapsed = time.time() - start


    print(
        "LLM HTTP:",
        response.status_code
    )

    print(
        "LLM time:",
        round(elapsed, 3),
        "sec"
    )


    response.raise_for_status()


    data = response.json()


    message = (
        data["choices"][0]["message"]
    )


    text = (
        message
        .get("content", "")
        .strip()
    )


    reasoning = message.get(
        "reasoning_content"
    )


    if reasoning:

        print(
            "WARNING: reasoning_content exists"
        )


    timings = data.get("timings")

    if timings:

        print(
            "LLM timings:",
            timings
        )


    if not text:

        raise RuntimeError(
            "Strata returned empty content"
        )


    return text


# ============================================================
# Health
# ============================================================

@app.get("/health")
def health():

    return {

        "status": "ok",

        "asr": ASR_URL,

        "llm": STRATA_MODEL,

        "tts": "sherpa-onnx",

        "mode": "ai"
    }


# ============================================================
# Voice API
# ============================================================

@app.post("/voice")
async def voice(
    file: UploadFile = File(...)
):

    total_start = time.time()


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Receive WAV from ESP32
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    wav_data = await file.read()


    print()
    print("=" * 70)

    print(
        "Received WAV:",
        len(wav_data),
        "bytes"
    )


    # ========================================================
    # ASR
    # ========================================================

    asr_start = time.time()


    try:

        response = requests.post(

            ASR_URL,

            files={

                "file": (
                    "recording.wav",
                    wav_data,
                    "audio/wav"
                )
            },

            data={
                "model": "sensevoice"
            },

            timeout=30
        )


        response.raise_for_status()

        result = response.json()


    except Exception as e:

        print(
            "ASR ERROR:",
            e
        )

        raise HTTPException(

            status_code=500,

            detail=f"ASR failed: {e}"
        )


    asr_elapsed = (
        time.time()
        - asr_start
    )


    asr_text = (
        result
        .get("text", "")
        .strip()
    )


    if not asr_text:

        raise HTTPException(

            status_code=500,

            detail="ASR returned empty text"
        )


    print()
    print("USER:")

    print(asr_text)


    print(
        "ASR time:",
        round(asr_elapsed, 3),
        "sec"
    )


    # ========================================================
    # LLM
    # ========================================================

    try:

        reply_text = call_strata(
            asr_text
        )


    except Exception as e:

        print(
            "LLM ERROR:",
            e
        )


        reply_text = (

            "抱歉，我现在无法连接语言模型。"

            "我听到你说的是，"

            + asr_text
        )


    print()
    print("ASSISTANT:")

    print(reply_text)


    # ========================================================
    # TTS
    # ========================================================

    tts_start = time.time()


    try:

        audio = tts.generate(

            text=reply_text,

            sid=0,

            speed=1.0
        )


    except Exception as e:

        print(
            "TTS ERROR:",
            e
        )

        raise HTTPException(

            status_code=500,

            detail=f"TTS failed: {e}"
        )


    tts_elapsed = (
        time.time()
        - tts_start
    )


    duration = (
        len(audio.samples)
        / audio.sample_rate
    )


    print(
        "TTS time:",
        round(tts_elapsed, 3),
        "sec"
    )


    print(
        "TTS audio:",
        round(duration, 2),
        "sec"
    )


    print(
        "TTS sample rate:",
        audio.sample_rate
    )


    # ========================================================
    # Generate WAV in memory
    # ========================================================

    wav_buffer = io.BytesIO()


    sf.write(

        wav_buffer,

        audio.samples,

        audio.sample_rate,

        format="WAV",

        subtype="PCM_16"
    )


    wav_bytes = (
        wav_buffer.getvalue()
    )


    # ========================================================
    # Timing
    # ========================================================

    total_elapsed = (
        time.time()
        - total_start
    )


    print()

    print(
        "Response WAV:",
        len(wav_bytes),
        "bytes"
    )


    print(
        "TOTAL latency:",
        round(total_elapsed, 3),
        "sec"
    )


    print("=" * 70)


    # ========================================================
    # Return WAV
    # ========================================================

    return Response(

        content=wav_bytes,

        media_type="audio/wav",

        headers={

            "X-ASR-Text-Hex":
                asr_text
                .encode("utf-8")
                .hex(),

            "X-Reply-Text-Hex":
                reply_text
                .encode("utf-8")
                .hex(),
        }
    )

Part 8 — ESP32 硬件

INMP441

INMP441      ESP32-S3

VDD     →    3V3
GND     →    GND
SCK     →    GPIO4
WS      →    GPIO5
SD      →    GPIO6
L/R     →    GND

MAX98357A

MAX98357A    ESP32-S3

VIN     →    5V
GND     →    GND
BCLK    →    GPIO15
LRC     →    GPIO16
DIN     →    GPIO17

Speaker：

MAX98357A + → Speaker +
MAX98357A - → Speaker -

不要把 Speaker - 接 ESP32 GND。

Part 9 — 完整 ESP32 V1 程序

Arduino IDE 中建立：

ESP32_Voice_Assistant_V1

主文件：

ESP32_Voice_Assistant_V1.ino

完整代码：

#include <Arduino.h>
#include <WiFi.h>
#include <HTTPClient.h>
#include "driver/i2s_std.h"
#include "esp_heap_caps.h"


// ============================================================
// WIFI
// ============================================================

const char* WIFI_SSID =
    "YOUR_WIFI_NAME";

const char* WIFI_PASSWORD =
    "YOUR_WIFI_PASSWORD";


// Voice Server
const char* VOICE_URL =
    "http://192.168.86.45:8080/voice";


// ============================================================
// MICROPHONE — INMP441
// ============================================================

#define MIC_BCLK 4
#define MIC_WS   5
#define MIC_SD   6


// ============================================================
// SPEAKER — MAX98357A
// ============================================================

#define SPK_BCLK 15
#define SPK_LRC  16
#define SPK_DIN  17


// ============================================================
// RECORDING
// ============================================================

#define RECORD_SAMPLE_RATE 16000

#define RECORD_SECONDS 6

#define WAV_HEADER_SIZE 44


const size_t TOTAL_SAMPLES =
    RECORD_SAMPLE_RATE
    * RECORD_SECONDS;


const size_t PCM_BYTES =
    TOTAL_SAMPLES
    * sizeof(int16_t);


int16_t* pcm_buffer = NULL;

uint8_t* wav_buffer = NULL;


uint8_t* response_buffer = NULL;

size_t response_size = 0;


// ============================================================
// I2S CHANNELS
// ============================================================

i2s_chan_handle_t mic_rx = NULL;

i2s_chan_handle_t spk_tx = NULL;


// ============================================================
// WAV HEADER
// ============================================================

void writeWavHeader(
    uint8_t* header,
    uint32_t dataSize,
    uint32_t sampleRate
) {

    uint32_t fileSize =
        dataSize + 36;

    uint32_t byteRate =
        sampleRate * 2;


    memcpy(
        header,
        "RIFF",
        4
    );


    memcpy(
        header + 4,
        &fileSize,
        4
    );


    memcpy(
        header + 8,
        "WAVEfmt ",
        8
    );


    uint32_t subchunk1 = 16;

    memcpy(
        header + 16,
        &subchunk1,
        4
    );


    uint16_t audioFormat = 1;

    uint16_t channels = 1;

    uint16_t bits = 16;

    uint16_t blockAlign = 2;


    memcpy(
        header + 20,
        &audioFormat,
        2
    );


    memcpy(
        header + 22,
        &channels,
        2
    );


    memcpy(
        header + 24,
        &sampleRate,
        4
    );


    memcpy(
        header + 28,
        &byteRate,
        4
    );


    memcpy(
        header + 32,
        &blockAlign,
        2
    );


    memcpy(
        header + 34,
        &bits,
        2
    );


    memcpy(
        header + 36,
        "data",
        4
    );


    memcpy(
        header + 40,
        &dataSize,
        4
    );
}


// ============================================================
// MICROPHONE SETUP
// ============================================================

void setupMicrophone() {

    i2s_chan_config_t cfg =
        I2S_CHANNEL_DEFAULT_CONFIG(
            I2S_NUM_0,
            I2S_ROLE_MASTER
        );


    ESP_ERROR_CHECK(
        i2s_new_channel(
            &cfg,
            NULL,
            &mic_rx
        )
    );


    i2s_std_config_t std_cfg = {

        .clk_cfg =
            I2S_STD_CLK_DEFAULT_CONFIG(
                RECORD_SAMPLE_RATE
            ),

        .slot_cfg =
            I2S_STD_PHILIPS_SLOT_DEFAULT_CONFIG(
                I2S_DATA_BIT_WIDTH_32BIT,
                I2S_SLOT_MODE_MONO
            ),

        .gpio_cfg = {

            .mclk =
                I2S_GPIO_UNUSED,

            .bclk =
                (gpio_num_t)MIC_BCLK,

            .ws =
                (gpio_num_t)MIC_WS,

            .dout =
                I2S_GPIO_UNUSED,

            .din =
                (gpio_num_t)MIC_SD,

            .invert_flags = {
                false,
                false,
                false
            }
        }
    };


    std_cfg.slot_cfg.slot_mask =
        I2S_STD_SLOT_LEFT;


    ESP_ERROR_CHECK(
        i2s_channel_init_std_mode(
            mic_rx,
            &std_cfg
        )
    );


    ESP_ERROR_CHECK(
        i2s_channel_enable(
            mic_rx
        )
    );
}


// ============================================================
// SPEAKER SETUP
// ============================================================

void setupSpeaker(
    uint32_t sampleRate
) {

    if (spk_tx != NULL) {

        i2s_channel_disable(
            spk_tx
        );

        i2s_del_channel(
            spk_tx
        );

        spk_tx = NULL;
    }


    i2s_chan_config_t cfg =
        I2S_CHANNEL_DEFAULT_CONFIG(
            I2S_NUM_1,
            I2S_ROLE_MASTER
        );


    ESP_ERROR_CHECK(
        i2s_new_channel(
            &cfg,
            &spk_tx,
            NULL
        )
    );


    i2s_std_config_t std_cfg = {

        .clk_cfg =
            I2S_STD_CLK_DEFAULT_CONFIG(
                sampleRate
            ),

        .slot_cfg =
            I2S_STD_PHILIPS_SLOT_DEFAULT_CONFIG(
                I2S_DATA_BIT_WIDTH_16BIT,
                I2S_SLOT_MODE_MONO
            ),

        .gpio_cfg = {

            .mclk =
                I2S_GPIO_UNUSED,

            .bclk =
                (gpio_num_t)SPK_BCLK,

            .ws =
                (gpio_num_t)SPK_LRC,

            .dout =
                (gpio_num_t)SPK_DIN,

            .din =
                I2S_GPIO_UNUSED,

            .invert_flags = {
                false,
                false,
                false
            }
        }
    };


    std_cfg.slot_cfg.slot_mask =
        I2S_STD_SLOT_LEFT;


    ESP_ERROR_CHECK(
        i2s_channel_init_std_mode(
            spk_tx,
            &std_cfg
        )
    );


    ESP_ERROR_CHECK(
        i2s_channel_enable(
            spk_tx
        )
    );
}


// ============================================================
// WIFI
// ============================================================

void connectWiFi() {

    WiFi.mode(
        WIFI_STA
    );


    WiFi.begin(
        WIFI_SSID,
        WIFI_PASSWORD
    );


    Serial.print(
        "Connecting WiFi"
    );


    while (
        WiFi.status()
        != WL_CONNECTED
    ) {

        Serial.print(".");

        delay(500);
    }


    Serial.println();


    Serial.print(
        "ESP32 IP: "
    );


    Serial.println(
        WiFi.localIP()
    );


    Serial.print(
        "Signal: "
    );


    Serial.print(
        WiFi.RSSI()
    );


    Serial.println(
        " dBm"
    );
}


// ============================================================
// RECORD
// ============================================================

void recordAudio() {

    Serial.println();

    Serial.println(
        "=========================="
    );

    Serial.println(
        "RECORDING 6 SECONDS"
    );

    Serial.println(
        "SPEAK NOW!"
    );

    Serial.println(
        "=========================="
    );


    int32_t raw[256];

    size_t recorded = 0;


    while (
        recorded
        < TOTAL_SAMPLES
    ) {

        size_t bytesRead = 0;


        esp_err_t result =
            i2s_channel_read(

                mic_rx,

                raw,

                sizeof(raw),

                &bytesRead,

                portMAX_DELAY
            );


        if (
            result != ESP_OK
        ) {

            continue;
        }


        int count =
            bytesRead
            / sizeof(int32_t);


        for (
            int i = 0;

            i < count
            && recorded
               < TOTAL_SAMPLES;

            i++
        ) {

            int32_t sample =
                raw[i] >> 14;


            // Software microphone gain

            sample *= 4;


            if (
                sample > 32767
            ) {

                sample = 32767;
            }


            if (
                sample < -32768
            ) {

                sample = -32768;
            }


            pcm_buffer[
                recorded++
            ] =
                (int16_t)sample;
        }
    }


    writeWavHeader(

        wav_buffer,

        PCM_BYTES,

        RECORD_SAMPLE_RATE
    );


    memcpy(

        wav_buffer
        + WAV_HEADER_SIZE,

        pcm_buffer,

        PCM_BYTES
    );


    Serial.println(
        "Recording finished."
    );


    Serial.print(
        "WAV size: "
    );


    Serial.println(
        PCM_BYTES
        + WAV_HEADER_SIZE
    );
}


// ============================================================
// SEND TO VOICE SERVER
// ============================================================

bool sendVoice() {

    WiFiClient client;

    HTTPClient http;


    http.begin(
        client,
        VOICE_URL
    );


    http.setTimeout(
        60000
    );


    String boundary =
        "----ESP32Voice";


    String startPart =

        "--"
        + boundary
        + "\r\n"

        "Content-Disposition: form-data; "
        "name=\"file\"; "
        "filename=\"recording.wav\"\r\n"

        "Content-Type: audio/wav\r\n\r\n";


    String endPart =

        "\r\n--"
        + boundary
        + "--\r\n";


    size_t bodySize =

        startPart.length()

        + WAV_HEADER_SIZE

        + PCM_BYTES

        + endPart.length();


    uint8_t* body =
        (uint8_t*)
        heap_caps_malloc(

            bodySize,

            MALLOC_CAP_SPIRAM
        );


    if (!body) {

        Serial.println(
            "Cannot allocate HTTP body"
        );

        return false;
    }


    size_t p = 0;


    memcpy(

        body + p,

        startPart.c_str(),

        startPart.length()
    );


    p +=
        startPart.length();


    memcpy(

        body + p,

        wav_buffer,

        WAV_HEADER_SIZE
        + PCM_BYTES
    );


    p +=
        WAV_HEADER_SIZE
        + PCM_BYTES;


    memcpy(

        body + p,

        endPart.c_str(),

        endPart.length()
    );


    http.addHeader(

        "Content-Type",

        "multipart/form-data; boundary="
        + boundary
    );


    Serial.println();

    Serial.println(
        "Sending to Voice Server..."
    );


    int code =
        http.POST(
            body,
            bodySize
        );


    free(body);


    Serial.print(
        "HTTP status: "
    );


    Serial.println(code);


    if (
        code != 200
    ) {

        Serial.println(
            "Server error:"
        );

        Serial.println(
            http.getString()
        );


        http.end();

        return false;
    }


    int len =
        http.getSize();


    Serial.print(
        "Response size: "
    );


    Serial.println(len);


    if (
        len <= 44
    ) {

        Serial.println(
            "Invalid WAV response"
        );


        http.end();

        return false;
    }


    response_buffer =
        (uint8_t*)
        heap_caps_malloc(

            len,

            MALLOC_CAP_SPIRAM
        );


    if (
        !response_buffer
    ) {

        Serial.println(
            "Cannot allocate response buffer"
        );


        http.end();

        return false;
    }


    WiFiClient* stream =
        http.getStreamPtr();


    size_t received = 0;


    while (
        received
        < (size_t)len
    ) {

        size_t available =
            stream->available();


        if (
            available > 0
        ) {

            size_t wanted =
                min(
                    available,
                    (size_t)len
                    - received
                );


            int r =
                stream->readBytes(

                    response_buffer
                    + received,

                    wanted
                );


            if (
                r > 0
            ) {

                received += r;
            }
        }

        else {

            delay(1);
        }
    }


    response_size =
        received;


    http.end();


    Serial.println(
        "Voice response received."
    );


    return true;
}


// ============================================================
// PLAY RESPONSE
// ============================================================

void playResponse() {

    if (
        !response_buffer
        || response_size < 44
    ) {

        return;
    }


    uint32_t sampleRate = 0;


    memcpy(

        &sampleRate,

        response_buffer + 24,

        4
    );


    Serial.print(
        "TTS sample rate: "
    );


    Serial.println(
        sampleRate
    );


    setupSpeaker(
        sampleRate
    );


    // V1 assumes a standard
    // 44-byte PCM WAV header.

    uint8_t* audioData =
        response_buffer
        + 44;


    size_t audioSize =
        response_size
        - 44;


    Serial.println(
        "Playing response..."
    );


    size_t position = 0;


    while (
        position
        < audioSize
    ) {

        size_t chunk =
            min(

                (size_t)2048,

                audioSize
                - position
            );


        size_t written = 0;


        esp_err_t result =
            i2s_channel_write(

                spk_tx,

                audioData
                + position,

                chunk,

                &written,

                portMAX_DELAY
            );


        if (
            result == ESP_OK
        ) {

            position +=
                written;
        }
    }


    Serial.println(
        "Playback finished."
    );


    free(
        response_buffer
    );


    response_buffer =
        NULL;


    response_size =
        0;
}


// ============================================================
// SETUP
// ============================================================

void setup() {

    Serial.begin(
        115200
    );


    delay(
        1500
    );


    Serial.println();

    Serial.println(
        "ESP32-S3 AI Voice Assistant V1"
    );


    Serial.print(
        "Free PSRAM: "
    );


    Serial.println(
        ESP.getFreePsram()
    );


    pcm_buffer =
        (int16_t*)
        heap_caps_malloc(

            PCM_BYTES,

            MALLOC_CAP_SPIRAM
        );


    wav_buffer =
        (uint8_t*)
        heap_caps_malloc(

            PCM_BYTES
            + WAV_HEADER_SIZE,

            MALLOC_CAP_SPIRAM
        );


    if (
        !pcm_buffer
        || !wav_buffer
    ) {

        Serial.println(
            "PSRAM allocation failed!"
        );


        while (true) {

            delay(1000);
        }
    }


    setupMicrophone();


    connectWiFi();


    delay(
        1500
    );


    recordAudio();


    if (
        sendVoice()
    ) {

        playResponse();
    }


    Serial.println();

    Serial.println(
        "=========================="
    );

    Serial.println(
        "TEST COMPLETE"
    );

    Serial.println(
        "Press RESET to talk again."
    );

    Serial.println(
        "=========================="
    );
}


// ============================================================
// LOOP
// ============================================================

void loop() {

    delay(
        1000
    );
}

确认两个服务都存在。

最后 RESET ESP32。

Part 12 — WSL 网络

Windows：

%USERPROFILE%\.wslconfig

内容：

[wsl2]
networkingMode=mirrored

修改以后：

wsl --shutdown

重新进入 WSL。

服务器必须监听：

0.0.0.0:8000
0.0.0.0:8080

ESP32 使用 Windows/WSL 所在机器的 LAN IP，例如：

192.168.86.45

因此：

http://192.168.86.45:8080/voice

在本次测试中：

  • WSL localhost 正常；

  • Windows localhost 正常；

  • Windows 自己访问 192.168.86.45 曾出现异常；

  • 同一 LAN 上的手机可以正常访问；

  • ESP32 可以正常访问。

因此不要只依靠 Windows 自己访问自己 LAN IP 的结果判断 WSL 服务是否可被 LAN 访问。

长期部署建议直接使用原生 Ubuntu，可以避免 WSL mirrored networking、Hyper-V Firewall 等复杂性。

You said:

好吧，现在我们开始尝试做自动回答的吧,这样就不用每次都等 6 秒了。 还有，我现在发现我这个喇叭声音比较小，是因为我 volume 没有调对，还是说现在已经是最大声音了？ 另外，个别时候喇叭里可能会有噪音，就是我不说话时会有噪音。

ChatGPT said:

可以。现在最值得做的是 V2.1：自动检测讲话 + 自动判断讲话结束 + 自动进入下一轮。先不碰服务器端，主要修改 ESP32。

另外你说的两个 Speaker 问题，我建议一起处理，因为它们和 I2S 状态有关。

1. 先说 Speaker 音量

你现在程序里的：

C++
i2s_channel_write(...)

基本是把 TTS 的 PCM 原始幅度直接送给 MAX98357A，ESP32 端目前没有软件音量控制。

MAX98357A 本身还有 GAIN 引脚，可以设置硬件增益。不同模块的具体 GAIN 电阻配置可能略有差异，但常见 MAX98357A 芯片增益范围大约是 3–15 dB。

所以声音小可能来自三方面：

  • TTS PCM 本身幅度不大；
  • ESP32 没做数字增益；
  • MAX98357A 的 GAIN 当前使用默认增益。

我建议先不要动 GAIN 接线，先加软件 Volume。这样最容易调，而且不会一下子把喇叭推得太狠。

例如：

C++
#define SPEAKER_VOLUME 1.8f

播放之前对 PCM 做：

C++
int32_t v = sample * SPEAKER_VOLUME; if (v > 32767) v = 32767; if (v < -32768) v = -32768;

先试：

Plain text
1.0 = 原来音量 1.5 = +约3.5 dB 2.0 = +约6 dB

建议从 1.5 开始。

2. 不讲话时有噪音

这个现象我比较怀疑 MAX98357A 一直处于 Enable 状态。

现在：

Plain text
播放完成 ↓ I2S 仍然 Enable ↓ MAX98357A 仍然工作 ↓ Speaker ↓ 可能出现 hiss / hum / 数字噪声

更好的做法是：

Plain text
准备播放 ↓ Enable I2S ↓ 播放 ↓ 写入一小段 0 ↓ Disable I2S ↓ MAX98357A 静音

更进一步，可以把 MAX98357A 的 SD（Shutdown） 接一个 ESP32 GPIO：

Plain text
ESP32 GPIO ↓ MAX98357A SD

播放：

Plain text
SD HIGH → Amplifier ON

不播放：

Plain text
SD LOW → Amplifier OFF

这个是我最终更推荐的办法。 待机时功放直接 shutdown，通常比单纯停止 I2S 更干净。

不过第一版先软件 disable I2S，看看噪音是否已经消失。

3. 自动讲话检测：不要固定 6 秒

现在：

Plain text
RESET ↓ 录音6秒 ↓ 回答 ↓ 结束

我们改成：

Plain text
一直监听麦克风 ↓ 声音超过阈值 ↓ 连续检测到讲话约100ms ↓ 开始录音 ↓ 讲话…… 讲话…… 讲话…… ↓ 连续静音约800ms ↓ 自动停止 ↓ ASR → Qwen → TTS ↓ Speaker回答 ↓ 等待约300ms ↓ 重新监听

这样就已经很像真正的语音助手了。

4. 第一版先用简单 Energy VAD

现在没有必要上复杂神经网络 VAD。

INMP441 已经不断产生 PCM，我们直接计算：

Plain text
absolute(sample)

或者 RMS。

例如：

C++
float calculateRMS( int16_t* samples, int count ) { uint64_t sum = 0; for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) { int32_t s = samples[i]; sum += s * s; } return sqrt( (double)sum / count ); }

然后设阈值：

C++
#define VAD_THRESHOLD 500

这个 500 只是起始值，需要根据你的麦克风实际噪声调整。

例如你可能测出来：

Plain text
安静： RMS 70–150 正常讲话： RMS 800–3000 拍手： RMS 8000+

那就可以设：

Plain text
VAD_THRESHOLD = 400

5. 不再固定 6 秒，但仍设置最大录音长度

不能无限录。

建议：

C++
#define MAX_RECORD_SECONDS 15 #define SILENCE_END_MS 800 #define SPEECH_START_MS 100

因此：

Plain text
最短： 检测讲话 → 开始 结束： 静音800ms → Stop 最长： 15秒 → 强制Stop

PSRAM 完全够：

Plain text
16000 × 2 × 15 ≈ 480KB

6. ESP32 的核心录音逻辑改成这样

先把：

C++
#define RECORD_SECONDS 6

换成：

C++
#define MAX_RECORD_SECONDS 15 #define VAD_THRESHOLD 500 #define SPEECH_START_MS 100 #define SILENCE_END_MS 800

然后：

C++
const size_t MAX_SAMPLES = RECORD_SAMPLE_RATE * MAX_RECORD_SECONDS; const size_t MAX_PCM_BYTES = MAX_SAMPLES * sizeof(int16_t);

录音函数核心改成：

C++
size_t recordWithVAD() { Serial.println(); Serial.println("Waiting for speech..."); int32_t raw[256]; bool speaking = false; unsigned long speechStart = 0; unsigned long silenceStart = 0; size_t recorded = 0; while (true) { size_t bytesRead = 0; if ( i2s_channel_read( mic_rx, raw, sizeof(raw), &bytesRead, portMAX_DELAY ) != ESP_OK ) { continue; } int count = bytesRead / sizeof(int32_t); double sum = 0; for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) { int32_t sample = raw[i] >> 14; sample *= 4; if (sample > 32767) sample = 32767; if (sample < -32768) sample = -32768; int16_t pcm = (int16_t)sample; sum += (double)pcm * (double)pcm; // Only store after speech starts if ( speaking && recorded < MAX_SAMPLES ) { pcm_buffer[ recorded++ ] = pcm; } } float rms = sqrt( sum / count ); bool voice = rms > VAD_THRESHOLD; // -------------------------------- // Waiting for speech // -------------------------------- if (!speaking) { if (voice) { if ( speechStart == 0 ) { speechStart = millis(); } if ( millis() - speechStart >= SPEECH_START_MS ) { speaking = true; silenceStart = 0; Serial.println( "Speech detected." ); } } else { speechStart = 0; } continue; } // -------------------------------- // Recording speech // -------------------------------- if (voice) { silenceStart = 0; } else { if ( silenceStart == 0 ) { silenceStart = millis(); } if ( millis() - silenceStart >= SILENCE_END_MS ) { Serial.println( "End of speech detected." ); break; } } // Maximum recording length if ( recorded >= MAX_SAMPLES ) { Serial.println( "Maximum recording time reached." ); break; } } Serial.print( "Recorded samples: " ); Serial.println( recorded ); return recorded; }

这里有一个小问题：它从确定 speaking=true 后才保存，因此会损失最开始约 100ms。正式版我们会加 pre-roll ring buffer，保留讲话前约 200–300ms。

但第一版完全可以先这样测试。

7. WAV 长度也要改成动态

以前固定：

C++
PCM_BYTES

现在变成：

C++
size_t recordedSamples = recordWithVAD(); size_t recordedBytes = recordedSamples * sizeof(int16_t);

WAV：

C++
writeWavHeader( wav_buffer, recordedBytes, RECORD_SAMPLE_RATE ); memcpy( wav_buffer + WAV_HEADER_SIZE, pcm_buffer, recordedBytes );

HTTP POST 也使用：

C++
recordedBytes

而不能继续使用原来的固定 PCM_BYTES。

8. 回答完以后自动重新监听

原来的：

C++
void loop() { delay(1000); }

最终改成真正的：

C++
void loop() { size_t recordedSamples = recordWithVAD(); if ( recordedSamples < RECORD_SAMPLE_RATE / 4 ) { return; } size_t recordedBytes = recordedSamples * sizeof(int16_t); buildWav( recordedBytes ); if ( sendVoice( recordedBytes ) ) { playResponse(); } // Avoid detecting our own speaker tail delay(500); }

这样就：

Plain text
你说话 ↓ 自动识别结束 ↓ AI回答 ↓ 自动重新监听 ↓ 你继续问 ↓ AI继续回答

完全不用 RESET。

9. 但这里还有一个很重要的问题：Echo

当 Speaker 在讲话：

Plain text
MAX98357A ↓ Speaker ↓ 空气 INMP441

麦克风也能听到自己的 AI 回答。

如果处理不好，就会出现：

AI 回答 → 麦克风听到 AI → 当成用户说话 → 又回答自己 → 无限循环。

所以我们的第一版逻辑必须是：

Plain text
LISTEN ↓ RECORD ↓ 停止麦克风判断 ↓ ASR / LLM / TTS ↓ PLAYBACK ↓ 等待500ms ↓ LISTEN

也就是说 播放期间不做 VAD。

后期真正做“小智式打断”时，再增加 AEC（Acoustic Echo Cancellation）。

我建议现在的实现顺序

先不要同时改很多东西：

  1. V2.1：Energy VAD + 自动停止 + 自动循环
  2. V2.2：Speaker 软件 Volume + 播放后 I2S disable
  3. 调好 VAD_THRESHOLD，解决环境噪音误触发
  4. 再考虑 MAX98357A SD 接 GPIO，实现真正硬件静音
  5. 最后再做 Streaming / AEC / 打断

你现在最需要的是一份基于我们已经跑通的 V1 ESP32 程序，完整可直接编译的 V2 .ino，而不是自己把上面这些代码片段拼起来。

ESP32_Voice_Assistant_V2_1.ino

#include <Arduino.h> #include <WiFi.h> #include <HTTPClient.h> #include <math.h> #include "driver/i2s_std.h" #include "esp_heap_caps.h" // ============================================================ // WiFi // ============================================================ const char* WIFI_SSID = "YOUR_WIFI_NAME"; const char* WIFI_PASSWORD = "YOUR_WIFI_PASSWORD"; const char* VOICE_URL = "http://192.168.86.45:8080/voice"; // ============================================================ // INMP441 Microphone // ============================================================ #define MIC_BCLK 4 #define MIC_WS 5 #define MIC_SD 6 // ============================================================ // MAX98357A Speaker // ============================================================ #define SPK_BCLK 15 #define SPK_LRC 16 #define SPK_DIN 17 // ============================================================ // Audio // ============================================================ #define SAMPLE_RATE 16000 // Maximum user speech length #define MAX_RECORD_SECONDS 15 // ============================================================ // VAD // ============================================================ // Starting value. // We will tune this after looking at Serial Monitor. #define VAD_THRESHOLD 500.0f // Voice must stay above threshold this long before starting. #define SPEECH_START_MS 120 // Stop recording after this much continuous silence. #define SILENCE_END_MS 800 // Keep audio BEFORE speech detection so the first word isn't lost. #define PRE_ROLL_MS 250 // Ignore very short recordings. #define MIN_RECORD_MS 300 // Delay after speaker playback before listening again. #define POST_PLAYBACK_DELAY_MS 500 // Print RMS while waiting for speech. // Useful for tuning VAD. #define PRINT_RMS true #define RMS_PRINT_INTERVAL_MS 250 // ============================================================ // Derived sizes // ============================================================ const size_t MAX_SAMPLES = SAMPLE_RATE * MAX_RECORD_SECONDS; const size_t MAX_PCM_BYTES = MAX_SAMPLES * sizeof(int16_t); const size_t WAV_HEADER_SIZE = 44; const size_t PRE_ROLL_SAMPLES = (SAMPLE_RATE * PRE_ROLL_MS) / 1000; // ============================================================ // Buffers // ============================================================ int16_t* pcm_buffer = NULL; int16_t* pre_roll_buffer = NULL; uint8_t* wav_buffer = NULL; uint8_t* response_buffer = NULL; size_t response_size = 0; // ============================================================ // I2S handles // ============================================================ i2s_chan_handle_t mic_rx = NULL; i2s_chan_handle_t spk_tx = NULL; // ============================================================ // WAV header // ============================================================ void writeWavHeader( uint8_t* header, uint32_t dataSize, uint32_t sampleRate ) { uint32_t fileSize = dataSize + 36; uint32_t byteRate = sampleRate * 2; uint16_t audioFormat = 1; uint16_t channels = 1; uint16_t bitsPerSample = 16; uint16_t blockAlign = 2; uint32_t fmtSize = 16; memcpy(header, "RIFF", 4); memcpy(header + 4, &fileSize, 4); memcpy(header + 8, "WAVE", 4); memcpy(header + 12, "fmt ", 4); memcpy(header + 16, &fmtSize, 4); memcpy(header + 20, &audioFormat, 2); memcpy(header + 22, &channels, 2); memcpy(header + 24, &sampleRate, 4); memcpy(header + 28, &byteRate, 4); memcpy(header + 32, &blockAlign, 2); memcpy(header + 34, &bitsPerSample, 2); memcpy(header + 36, "data", 4); memcpy(header + 40, &dataSize, 4); } // ============================================================ // Microphone setup // ============================================================ void setupMicrophone() { i2s_chan_config_t chan_cfg = I2S_CHANNEL_DEFAULT_CONFIG( I2S_NUM_0, I2S_ROLE_MASTER ); ESP_ERROR_CHECK( i2s_new_channel( &chan_cfg, NULL, &mic_rx ) ); i2s_std_config_t std_cfg = { .clk_cfg = I2S_STD_CLK_DEFAULT_CONFIG( SAMPLE_RATE ), .slot_cfg = I2S_STD_PHILIPS_SLOT_DEFAULT_CONFIG( I2S_DATA_BIT_WIDTH_32BIT, I2S_SLOT_MODE_MONO ), .gpio_cfg = { .mclk = I2S_GPIO_UNUSED, .bclk = (gpio_num_t)MIC_BCLK, .ws = (gpio_num_t)MIC_WS, .dout = I2S_GPIO_UNUSED, .din = (gpio_num_t)MIC_SD, .invert_flags = { .mclk_inv = false, .bclk_inv = false, .ws_inv = false } } }; // INMP441 L/R -> GND std_cfg.slot_cfg.slot_mask = I2S_STD_SLOT_LEFT; ESP_ERROR_CHECK( i2s_channel_init_std_mode( mic_rx, &std_cfg ) ); ESP_ERROR_CHECK( i2s_channel_enable( mic_rx ) ); } // ============================================================ // Speaker setup // ============================================================ void setupSpeaker( uint32_t sampleRate ) { if (spk_tx != NULL) { i2s_channel_disable(spk_tx); i2s_del_channel(spk_tx); spk_tx = NULL; } i2s_chan_config_t chan_cfg = I2S_CHANNEL_DEFAULT_CONFIG( I2S_NUM_1, I2S_ROLE_MASTER ); ESP_ERROR_CHECK( i2s_new_channel( &chan_cfg, &spk_tx, NULL ) ); i2s_std_config_t std_cfg = { .clk_cfg = I2S_STD_CLK_DEFAULT_CONFIG( sampleRate ), .slot_cfg = I2S_STD_PHILIPS_SLOT_DEFAULT_CONFIG( I2S_DATA_BIT_WIDTH_16BIT, I2S_SLOT_MODE_MONO ), .gpio_cfg = { .mclk = I2S_GPIO_UNUSED, .bclk = (gpio_num_t)SPK_BCLK, .ws = (gpio_num_t)SPK_LRC, .dout = (gpio_num_t)SPK_DIN, .din = I2S_GPIO_UNUSED, .invert_flags = { .mclk_inv = false, .bclk_inv = false, .ws_inv = false } } }; std_cfg.slot_cfg.slot_mask = I2S_STD_SLOT_LEFT; ESP_ERROR_CHECK( i2s_channel_init_std_mode( spk_tx, &std_cfg ) ); ESP_ERROR_CHECK( i2s_channel_enable( spk_tx ) ); } // ============================================================ // WiFi // ============================================================ void connectWiFi() { WiFi.mode(WIFI_STA); WiFi.begin( WIFI_SSID, WIFI_PASSWORD ); Serial.print("Connecting WiFi"); while ( WiFi.status() != WL_CONNECTED ) { Serial.print("."); delay(500); } Serial.println(); Serial.print("ESP32 IP: "); Serial.println(WiFi.localIP()); Serial.print("WiFi RSSI: "); Serial.print(WiFi.RSSI()); Serial.println(" dBm"); } // ============================================================ // Convert INMP441 32-bit sample to 16-bit PCM // ============================================================ inline int16_t convertMicSample( int32_t raw ) { int32_t sample = raw >> 14; // Same microphone gain as V1 sample *= 4; if (sample > 32767) sample = 32767; if (sample < -32768) sample = -32768; return (int16_t)sample; } // ============================================================ // Calculate RMS // ============================================================ float calculateRMS( const int16_t* samples, int count ) { if (count <= 0) return 0; double sum = 0; for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) { double s = samples[i]; sum += s * s; } return sqrt(sum / count); } // ============================================================ // Add sample to circular pre-roll buffer // ============================================================ size_t pre_roll_pos = 0; size_t pre_roll_count = 0; void addToPreRoll( int16_t sample ) { pre_roll_buffer[ pre_roll_pos ] = sample; pre_roll_pos++; if ( pre_roll_pos >= PRE_ROLL_SAMPLES ) { pre_roll_pos = 0; } if ( pre_roll_count < PRE_ROLL_SAMPLES ) { pre_roll_count++; } } // ============================================================ // Copy pre-roll into main recording buffer // ============================================================ size_t copyPreRoll() { if ( pre_roll_count == 0 ) { return 0; } size_t start; if ( pre_roll_count < PRE_ROLL_SAMPLES ) { start = 0; } else { start = pre_roll_pos; } size_t copied = 0; for ( size_t i = 0; i < pre_roll_count; i++ ) { size_t index = (start + i) % PRE_ROLL_SAMPLES; pcm_buffer[copied++] = pre_roll_buffer[index]; } return copied; } // ============================================================ // VAD recording // ============================================================ size_t recordWithVAD() { Serial.println(); Serial.println( "==========================" ); Serial.println( "WAITING FOR SPEECH..." ); Serial.println( "==========================" ); // Reset pre-roll pre_roll_pos = 0; pre_roll_count = 0; int32_t raw[256]; int16_t converted[256]; bool speaking = false; unsigned long speechCandidateStart = 0; unsigned long silenceStart = 0; unsigned long lastRmsPrint = 0; size_t recorded = 0; while (true) { size_t bytesRead = 0; esp_err_t result = i2s_channel_read( mic_rx, raw, sizeof(raw), &bytesRead, portMAX_DELAY ); if ( result != ESP_OK ) { continue; } int count = bytesRead / sizeof(int32_t); if (count <= 0) continue; // Convert block to 16-bit PCM for ( int i = 0; i < count; i++ ) { converted[i] = convertMicSample( raw[i] ); } // Calculate block RMS float rms = calculateRMS( converted, count ); // Print RMS while waiting. // This is how we tune VAD_THRESHOLD. if ( PRINT_RMS && millis() - lastRmsPrint >= RMS_PRINT_INTERVAL_MS ) { Serial.print( speaking ? "REC RMS: " : "WAIT RMS: " ); Serial.println(rms); lastRmsPrint = millis(); } bool voice = rms >= VAD_THRESHOLD; // ==================================================== // WAITING FOR SPEECH // ==================================================== if (!speaking) { // Always maintain pre-roll for ( int i = 0; i < count; i++ ) { addToPreRoll( converted[i] ); } if (voice) { if ( speechCandidateStart == 0 ) { speechCandidateStart = millis(); } if ( millis() - speechCandidateStart >= SPEECH_START_MS ) { speaking = true; silenceStart = 0; // Copy the previous ~250 ms // so we don't lose the first syllable. recorded = copyPreRoll(); Serial.println(); Serial.println( ">>> SPEECH DETECTED" ); Serial.print( "Pre-roll samples: " ); Serial.println( recorded ); } } else { speechCandidateStart = 0; } continue; } // ==================================================== // RECORDING // ==================================================== for ( int i = 0; i < count; i++ ) { if ( recorded >= MAX_SAMPLES ) { break; } pcm_buffer[ recorded++ ] = converted[i]; } // ==================================================== // Silence detection // ==================================================== if (voice) { silenceStart = 0; } else { if ( silenceStart == 0 ) { silenceStart = millis(); } if ( millis() - silenceStart >= SILENCE_END_MS ) { Serial.println(); Serial.println( ">>> END OF SPEECH" ); break; } } // ==================================================== // Maximum length // ==================================================== if ( recorded >= MAX_SAMPLES ) { Serial.println(); Serial.println( ">>> MAX RECORDING LENGTH" ); break; } } float seconds = (float)recorded / SAMPLE_RATE; Serial.print( "Recorded samples: " ); Serial.println( recorded ); Serial.print( "Recorded duration: " ); Serial.print( seconds, 2 ); Serial.println( " sec" ); return recorded; } // ============================================================ // Build dynamic WAV // ============================================================ size_t buildWav( size_t recordedSamples ) { size_t dataBytes = recordedSamples * sizeof(int16_t); writeWavHeader( wav_buffer, dataBytes, SAMPLE_RATE ); memcpy( wav_buffer + WAV_HEADER_SIZE, pcm_buffer, dataBytes ); size_t wavSize = WAV_HEADER_SIZE + dataBytes; Serial.print( "WAV size: " ); Serial.println( wavSize ); return wavSize; } // ============================================================ // Send WAV to Voice Server // ============================================================ bool sendVoice( size_t wavSize ) { if ( WiFi.status() != WL_CONNECTED ) { Serial.println( "WiFi disconnected. Reconnecting..." ); connectWiFi(); } WiFiClient client; HTTPClient http; http.begin( client, VOICE_URL ); // ASR + LLM + TTS can take several seconds. http.setTimeout( 60000 ); String boundary = "----ESP32Voice"; String startPart = "--" + boundary + "\r\n" "Content-Disposition: form-data; " "name=\"file\"; " "filename=\"recording.wav\"\r\n" "Content-Type: audio/wav\r\n\r\n"; String endPart = "\r\n--" + boundary + "--\r\n"; size_t bodySize = startPart.length() + wavSize + endPart.length(); uint8_t* body = (uint8_t*) heap_caps_malloc( bodySize, MALLOC_CAP_SPIRAM ); if (!body) { Serial.println( "ERROR: Cannot allocate HTTP body." ); return false; } size_t p = 0; memcpy( body + p, startPart.c_str(), startPart.length() ); p += startPart.length(); memcpy( body + p, wav_buffer, wavSize ); p += wavSize; memcpy( body + p, endPart.c_str(), endPart.length() ); http.addHeader( "Content-Type", "multipart/form-data; boundary=" + boundary ); Serial.println(); Serial.println( "Sending to Voice Server..." ); unsigned long requestStart = millis(); int code = http.POST( body, bodySize ); free(body); Serial.print( "HTTP status: " ); Serial.println(code); Serial.print( "Server round trip: " ); Serial.print( (millis() - requestStart) / 1000.0f, 2 ); Serial.println( " sec" ); if ( code != 200 ) { Serial.println( "Server error:" ); Serial.println( http.getString() ); http.end(); return false; } int len = http.getSize(); Serial.print( "Response size: " ); Serial.println(len); if ( len <= 44 ) { Serial.println( "ERROR: Invalid WAV response." ); http.end(); return false; } // Free old response if necessary if ( response_buffer != NULL ) { free( response_buffer ); response_buffer = NULL; } response_buffer = (uint8_t*) heap_caps_malloc( len, MALLOC_CAP_SPIRAM ); if ( !response_buffer ) { Serial.println( "ERROR: Cannot allocate response buffer." ); http.end(); return false; } WiFiClient* stream = http.getStreamPtr(); size_t received = 0; unsigned long lastData = millis(); while ( received < (size_t)len ) { size_t available = stream->available(); if ( available > 0 ) { size_t wanted = min( available, (size_t)len - received ); int r = stream->readBytes( response_buffer + received, wanted ); if ( r > 0 ) { received += r; lastData = millis(); } } else { // Additional protection against // hanging forever. if ( millis() - lastData > 10000 ) { Serial.println( "ERROR: Response download timeout." ); free( response_buffer ); response_buffer = NULL; http.end(); return false; } delay(1); } } response_size = received; http.end(); Serial.println( "Voice response received." ); return true; } // ============================================================ // Play returned WAV // ============================================================ void playResponse() { if ( !response_buffer || response_size < 44 ) { return; } // Basic WAV validation if ( memcmp( response_buffer, "RIFF", 4 ) != 0 || memcmp( response_buffer + 8, "WAVE", 4 ) != 0 ) { Serial.println( "ERROR: Response is not WAV." ); free( response_buffer ); response_buffer = NULL; response_size = 0; return; } uint32_t sampleRate = 0; memcpy( &sampleRate, response_buffer + 24, 4 ); Serial.print( "TTS sample rate: " ); Serial.println( sampleRate ); setupSpeaker( sampleRate ); // V2.1 still assumes the server-generated // PCM WAV uses the standard 44-byte header. uint8_t* audioData = response_buffer + 44; size_t audioSize = response_size - 44; Serial.println( "Playing response..." ); size_t position = 0; while ( position < audioSize ) { size_t chunk = min( (size_t)2048, audioSize - position ); size_t written = 0; esp_err_t result = i2s_channel_write( spk_tx, audioData + position, chunk, &written, portMAX_DELAY ); if ( result == ESP_OK ) { position += written; } } Serial.println( "Playback finished." ); free( response_buffer ); response_buffer = NULL; response_size = 0; // V2.1: // Stop speaker I2S after playback. // This may also reduce some idle noise. if ( spk_tx != NULL ) { i2s_channel_disable( spk_tx ); i2s_del_channel( spk_tx ); spk_tx = NULL; } } // ============================================================ // Setup // ============================================================ void setup() { Serial.begin( 115200 ); delay( 1500 ); Serial.println(); Serial.println( "ESP32-S3 AI Voice Assistant V2.1" ); Serial.print( "Free PSRAM: " ); Serial.println( ESP.getFreePsram() ); // Main PCM recording buffer pcm_buffer = (int16_t*) heap_caps_malloc( MAX_PCM_BYTES, MALLOC_CAP_SPIRAM ); // Dynamic WAV buffer wav_buffer = (uint8_t*) heap_caps_malloc( MAX_PCM_BYTES + WAV_HEADER_SIZE, MALLOC_CAP_SPIRAM ); // Pre-roll buffer pre_roll_buffer = (int16_t*) heap_caps_malloc( PRE_ROLL_SAMPLES * sizeof(int16_t), MALLOC_CAP_SPIRAM ); if ( !pcm_buffer || !wav_buffer || !pre_roll_buffer ) { Serial.println( "ERROR: PSRAM allocation failed!" ); while (true) { delay(1000); } } Serial.print( "Max recording buffer: " ); Serial.print( MAX_PCM_BYTES / 1024 ); Serial.println( " KB" ); setupMicrophone(); connectWiFi(); Serial.println(); Serial.println( "System ready." ); } // ============================================================ // Continuous conversation loop // ============================================================ void loop() { // -------------------------------------------------------- // 1. Wait for user and record automatically // -------------------------------------------------------- size_t recordedSamples = recordWithVAD(); size_t minimumSamples = ( SAMPLE_RATE * MIN_RECORD_MS ) / 1000; if ( recordedSamples < minimumSamples ) { Serial.println( "Recording too short. Ignored." ); delay(200); return; } // -------------------------------------------------------- // 2. Build dynamic WAV // -------------------------------------------------------- size_t wavSize = buildWav( recordedSamples ); // -------------------------------------------------------- // 3. ASR -> Qwen -> TTS // -------------------------------------------------------- bool success = sendVoice( wavSize ); // -------------------------------------------------------- // 4. Play AI response // -------------------------------------------------------- if (success) { playResponse(); } // -------------------------------------------------------- // 5. Prevent speaker tail from triggering VAD // -------------------------------------------------------- Serial.println(); Serial.println( "Returning to listening mode..." ); delay( POST_PLAYBACK_DELAY_MS ); }

第一次测试怎么做

服务器端仍然保持两个服务：

Bash
# Terminal 1 cd ~/voice-ai source venv/bin/activate funasr-server \ --model sensevoice \ --device cuda \ --host 0.0.0.0 \ --port 8000
Bash
# Terminal 2 cd ~/voice-ai source voice-server/bin/activate uvicorn voice_server:app \ --host 0.0.0.0 \ --port 8080

ESP32 烧录 V2.1 后，Serial Monitor 用：

Plain text
115200

启动后应该看到：

Plain text
ESP32-S3 AI Voice Assistant V2.1 Free PSRAM: ... Max recording buffer: 468 KB Connecting WiFi... ESP32 IP: ... System ready. ========================== WAITING FOR SPEECH... ========================== WAIT RMS: 83 WAIT RMS: 97 WAIT RMS: 105 ...

这时候先别急着测试 AI。先观察 10 秒左右 WAIT RMS。

然后正常距离说：

你好，请告诉我中国的首都是哪里。

讲话时可能看到：

Plain text
WAIT RMS: 135 WAIT RMS: 1260 >>> SPEECH DETECTED REC RMS: 1840 REC RMS: 2200 REC RMS: 1300 REC RMS: 110 REC RMS: 95 ... >>> END OF SPEECH Recorded duration: 2.84 sec WAV size: 90924 Sending to Voice Server...

之后 AI 回答，播放结束：

Plain text
Playback finished. Returning to listening mode... ========================== WAITING FOR SPEECH... ==========================

你可以直接继续问第二个问题，不需要 RESET。

最重要的是先调 VAD_THRESHOLD

我现在给你的：

C++
#define VAD_THRESHOLD 500.0f

只是一个合理的起始值，不代表你的 INMP441 最合适就是 500。

例如实际看到：

Plain text
安静： 80 95 110 130 正常讲话： 700 1200 1800 2500

那 500 很合适。

如果安静时已经：

Plain text
400 520 600

它会自己误触发。这时提高：

C++
#define VAD_THRESHOLD 800.0f

反过来，如果正常讲话只有：

Plain text
300 450 600

那么 500 太高，可以降到：

C++
#define VAD_THRESHOLD 250.0f

第一轮测试后，你把 Serial Monitor 中“安静时 RMS”和“正常讲话时 RMS”各贴几行给我。 我们就可以把阈值定得比较准确。

另外，这一版已经在播放结束后删除 Speaker I2S channel，所以你前面说的待机时偶尔有噪音可能会有所改善。但 MAX98357A 本身仍然处于供电状态；如果噪音仍然明显，V2.2 我们再把 SD 接到一个 GPIO，待机时真正关闭功放，同时加入软件音量控制。

You said:

我在台式机那边做语音识别和 TTS 生成的时候会用到 GPU，我在想是不是可以用一些不常用的、小的 GPU 来做这些服务。 我目前用的是 A4000，好像是 8GB 的一个老的、夸张的 GPU。我还有一个老的 Tesla P4 GPU，它性能比较低，好像也是 8GB，但我不知道做这个可不可以用。

ChatGPT said:

可以，而且我觉得 Tesla P4 很适合拿来专门跑你现在这套 ASR 服务。不过先纠正一个型号：你现在实际测试的卡从前面的 nvidia-smi 看是 Quadro RTX 4000 8GB，不是 RTX A4000。Quadro RTX 4000 是 Turing、Compute Capability 7.5；Tesla P4 则更老，是 Pascal、Compute Capability 6.1。NVIDIA Developer+1

对你现在这套系统，我会这样分配

服务Tesla P4 8GB建议
SenseVoiceSmall ASR可以⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 很适合
Sherpa/MeloTTS不需要 GPU继续 CPU
VAD不需要 GPUESP32/CPU
Strata Qwen 3.8 Flash不建议迁过去继续现在的机器
ASR + TTS Voice Server很适合 P4 主机推荐

P4 本来就是面向 inference 的低功耗卡：8GB GDDR5、192 GB/s 带宽、5.5 TFLOPS FP32、22 TOPS INT8，最大功耗约 75W。NVIDIA Images+1

所以它虽然老，但你的任务并不是训练大型模型，而是：

Plain text
ESP32 ↓ SenseVoiceSmall ← P4 ↓ Strata Qwen ← 另一台机器/现有服务 ↓ Sherpa TTS ← CPU ↓ ESP32

这正是 P4 擅长的“小模型推理”场景。

SenseVoice 甚至未必需要很强 GPU

SenseVoice 官方现在明确支持 CPU，也支持 GPU；FunASR 还提供了 SenseVoice 的 GGUF/llama.cpp 部署路线，可以跑 CPU、Vulkan 或 NVIDIA GPU。GitHub+1

因此我甚至建议你做一个实验：

Plain text
方案 A SenseVoice → P4 CUDA 方案 B SenseVoice → CPU 比较： ASR latency CPU usage GPU VRAM 整体 /voice latency

如果 CPU 已经比如 0.3–0.7 秒完成一段短语音识别，那么为了这个服务专门开 GPU 的价值都未必很大。

P4 唯一需要特别注意的是 CUDA/PyTorch 兼容性

P4 是 Compute Capability 6.1。NVIDIA Developer

而你当前环境是：

Plain text
PyTorch 2.11.0 + cu128 CUDA 12.8

我不会直接假设这一套 wheel 仍然包含 sm_61 的可执行 kernel。 这是把现在环境原封不动搬到 P4 上最大的潜在坑。

也就是说：

Plain text
P4 有 8GB显存 ← 没问题 SenseVoice 很小 ← 没问题 性能 ← 足够 真正需要验证： PyTorch/CUDA 当前版本是否仍支持 sm_61

另外，FunASR 目前提供的 Windows 预编译 CUDA SenseVoice 包明确针对 sm_86，所以那个包不能直接拿给 P4 用；P4 若走 llama.cpp GPU 路线，更适合 Linux 上自行构建对应架构，或者使用 Vulkan/CPU。GitHub+1

我反而很喜欢你这个部署方案

如果你准备把我们现在的 Voice Server 从日常台式机搬出去，我会考虑：

Plain text
专用旧 Ubuntu PC │ ├── Tesla P4 8GB │ └── SenseVoice ASR :8000 │ ├── CPU │ ├── Voice Server :8080 │ ├── Sherpa TTS │ └── VAD / API │ └── Network │ ├── ESP32 │ └── Strata Qwen ↓ strata.5742868.xyz

这样 Quadro RTX 4000 完全可以释放出来做别的事情。

而且 P4 只有 75W、单槽、低矮卡，本来就是服务器 inference 定位。NVIDIA Images

下一步最值得做的不是猜 P4 快不快，而是直接把 P4 装进那台 Ubuntu 机器，用同一段 test.wav 跑 20 次 SenseVoice，测平均 ASR latency。 如果能稳定在 1 秒以内，对你现在这个 ESP32 Voice Assistant 我认为就已经完全够用了。
